Taylor (People Ops): Quick company-wide nudge: annual SOC2/ISO attestations and privacy refresher are due Friday 23:59 UTC. Please finish the training, pick a single attestation owner for your team in the master sheet, and upload evidence to the secure portal. Links: https://redwood.internal/compliance/2026 and training: https://redwood.internal/training/privacy-2026

ComplianceBot: Reminders set (7d, 72h, 24h, 1h). Training completion dashboard updates hourly.

Zoe (Eng): Assigned myself for Core API. Will upload runbooks + change tickets tonight. Where should infra teams put provenance logs?

Alex (Security): Use the secure portal for raw logs. For SOC2-scoped services we need request-level traces (request_id, timestamp, instance_id). Non-scoped services can send aggregates. Redact payloads before public Drive uploads.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Small automation to bundle evidence (adds manifest + SHA256). Use at your own risk:
```bash
python infra/tools/pack_evidence.py --service core-api --out core-api-evidence.tar.gz --redact payloads
```
It auto-tags manifest with 'secure_upload' if asked.

Hiro (Legal): Note: vendor DPAs must be attached for any third-party artifacts. If procurement hasn't completed a DPA, add a note in the sheet and escalate to contracts@. Do NOT include confidential clauses in public attachments.

Maya (Audit): Audit will sample 2 services per org. We'll ask for runbook + incident timeline + one week raw logs for sampled services. Put 'audit_ready' in the spreadsheet when you think you're prepared.

Taylor (People Ops): If anyone needs help compiling artifacts, book a 20m slot: https://cal.redwood.com/taylor/compliance-help. Managers: please confirm training certs for direct reports before submitting attestations.

Zoe (Eng): One ask: some teams are on-call Fri. Any chance of a 48h buffer?

Taylor (People Ops): We can approve a 48h extension only for documented on-call conflicts with manager approval. DM me the manager sign-off. Prefer to keep exec review on schedule though.

ComplianceBot: Training export: https://redwood.internal/compliance/reports/pending-training.csv

Ravi (Eng-ML): Uploaded evidence link for ML infra: https://secure-upload.redwood.internal/compliance/2026/ml/rv-evidence.tar.gz and marked attestation_owner = ravi@redwood in sheet.

Taylor (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Final reminders will post 72/24/1h. Execs will receive a compliance recap Monday AM. Flag any potential sign-off blockers here ASAP. :mega:
